My role

I contributed Blueprint behaviour for a moon ability, including an explosion and shockwave. I did not create the moon model or texture, and the full game was a team effort.

Technical approach

My work covered effects that grew and faded over time, as well as ability behaviour affecting nearby enemies and the player's health.

Result

This was experience contributing a bounded feature to a much larger VR project and working within an existing team structure.
